lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Ga2Se4 (reduced formula BaGaSe2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ga centers as octahedrally coordinated by six Se neighbors, while Ba centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve Se neighbors. Ga-centered octahedra share corners with one another and faces with Ba-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
